title: Computer Science
description: ISC Class XII Computer Science (subject code 868), Paper I Theory (3 hours, 70 marks) and Paper II Practical (3 hours, 30 marks). The 2027 syllabus is Java-only; the separate CISCE ISC Computer Science 2028 syllabus adds an additional programming-language component that is not present in 2027.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Year 2027 Indian School Certificate Examination, Computer Science (868), Paper I Theory 3 hours 70 marks and Paper II Practical 3 hours 30 marks, Java 5.0 or later. Verified via accessible mirror/transcription of the CISCE 2027 document (AglaSem and Jagran Josh transcriptions of the official syllabus). Direct fetch from cisce.org was not available in this environment (HTTP 403).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified for examination year 2027. Section A: Boolean Algebra; Computer Hardware. Section B: Java (OOP, objects, primitives/wrappers/casting, variables/expressions, statements/scope, methods, arrays and strings, recursion). Section C: Inheritance/Interfaces/Polymorphism; Data Structures (stack, queue incl. circular queue and dequeue, infix-to-prefix/postfix, singly linked list, binary trees conceptual); Complexity and Big-O. The 2027 syllabus does not include that additional programming-language component; it belongs to the separate CISCE ISC Computer Science 2028 syllabus, not to 2027.

sections.title: Section A — Boolean Algebra and Computer Hardware
sections.paperLabel: ISC Class XII Computer Science (868) · 2027 · Paper I Theory 70 marks · Paper II Practical 30 marks
sections.description: Boolean Algebra and Computer Hardware: the two Section A theory topics prescribed for ISC Class XII Computer Science in the 2027 syllabus.

chapters.title: Boolean Algebra
chapters.blurb: Propositional logic, well-formed formulae, truth tables, Boolean laws and theorems, De Morgan's theorems, SOP/POS, minterms and maxterms, canonical and cardinal forms, K-map reduction up to four variables.

chapters.title: Computer Hardware: Logic Gates and Combinational Circuits
chapters.blurb: Logic gates NOT, AND, OR, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR; gate symbols, Boolean expressions and truth tables; half and full adders; encoders, decoders and multiplexers; universal NAND/NOR gates; conversion to NAND-only or NOR-only implementations.

sections.title: Section B — Java
sections.paperLabel: ISC Class XII Computer Science (868) · 2027 · Paper I Theory 70 marks · Paper II Practical 30 marks
sections.description: Java, as prescribed for Section B of the 2027 ISC Class XII Computer Science syllabus. The 2027 syllabus is Java-only.

chapters.title: OOP, Objects, Primitive Values, Wrapper Classes, Types and Casting
chapters.blurb: Object-oriented programming using Java; objects; primitive values and wrapper classes; types and casting; the object model and referencing objects.

chapters.title: Variables, Expressions
chapters.blurb: Variables, constants, expressions and type rules in Java; precedence and evaluation.

chapters.title: Statements and Scope
chapters.blurb: Statements, scope of variables, blocks, and the rules that govern visibility of declarations.

chapters.title: Methods
chapters.blurb: Methods and constructors, object as parameter and return data type, static methods, this, overloading versus overriding.

chapters.title: Arrays (Single and Double Dimensional) and String Handling
chapters.blurb: Single- and double-dimensional arrays, traversal and matrix processing, searching and sorting on arrays, and Java String handling including StringBuffer.

chapters.title: Recursion
chapters.blurb: Recursive definitions, base case and recursive step, tracing call and return sequences, and writing terminating recursive methods.

sections.title: Section C — Inheritance, Data Structures and Complexity
sections.paperLabel: ISC Class XII Computer Science (868) · 2027 · Paper I Theory 70 marks · Paper II Practical 30 marks
sections.description: Section C of the 2027 ISC Class XII Computer Science syllabus: Inheritance/Interfaces/Polymorphism; Data Structures; Complexity and Big-O. The 2027 syllabus is Java-only.

chapters.title: Inheritance, Interfaces and Polymorphism
chapters.blurb: Inheritance, method overriding, dynamic method dispatch, interfaces, and the distinction between overloading and overriding in Java.

chapters.title: Data Structures
chapters.blurb: Stacks, queues (including circular queue and dequeue), infix-to-prefix/postfix conversion, singly linked lists, and binary trees (conceptual), with structure-selection reasoning.

chapters.title: Stack
chapters.blurb: LIFO operations, overflow and underflow, array implementation, postfix evaluation and bracket matching.

chapters.title: Queue
chapters.blurb: FIFO operations, linear versus circular queues, false overflow, and scheduling applications.

chapters.title: Singly Linked List
chapters.blurb: Singly linked list nodes, insertion, deletion, reversal and sublist operations, and emptiness checks.

chapters.title: Binary Trees (Conceptual)
chapters.blurb: Binary tree concepts: root, internal and external nodes, height, depth, level, size, degree, siblings, subtree, completeness, balancing and traversals.

chapters.title: Complexity and Big-O Notation
chapters.blurb: Input size, dominant term, best/average/worst case, and analysis of searching and sorting algorithms using Big-O notation.
